items.item:
5. Every entry written, for every action that writes one, has the outcome
   `accepted`; no other outcome is ever stored.
   Shows A14-2. [witness: verification:registry_a14_every_entry_outcome_is_accepted]
statements:
```text
entry e exists <=> accepted action a in M09.actions, with changed(a) or a an
erasure of old entries, and e written in the transaction of a   -- A14-1
e.outcome = accepted   -- A14-2
```

verdicts.why: The helper checks the outcome of each newly written entry, and the selected test checks that every entry in the completed log has only the `accepted` outcome. It also verifies that the store contains exactly as many audit-entry rows as the checked log.
